Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays show the cardiac silhouette displaced into the right hemithorax with an abnormal contour and mediastinal shift, which is characteristic of right-sided cardiac herniation through a pericardial defect following pneumonectomy or extensive pleural surgery. This mechanical displacement causes acute hemodynamic compromise (obstruction of venous return or cardiac strangulation), distinguishing it from simple hemorrhage or tamponade.
